mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, activity_name, product_id, sku_id, flash_price, flash_pv, total_stock, available_stock, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_flash_sale_activity WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status=1 AND end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY start_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_flash_sale_activity(tenant_id, activity_name, product_id, sku_id, flash_price, flash_pv, total_stock, available_stock, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, version) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{activityName},#{productId},#{skuId},#{flashPrice},#{flashPv},#{totalStock},#{availableStock}, #{perUserLimit},#{startTime},#{endTime},#{status},0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_flash_sale_activity SET activity_name=#{activityName}, product_id=#{productId}, sku_id=#{skuId}, flash_price=#{flashPrice}, flash_pv=#{flashPv}, total_stock=#{totalStock}, available_stock=#{availableStock}, per_user_limit=#{perUserLimit}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, status=#{status}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE dms_flash_sale_activity SET status=#{status}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE dms_flash_sale_activity SET available_stock=available_stock-#{quantity}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND available_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE dms_flash_sale_activity SET available_stock=LEAST(total_stock, available_stock+#{quantity}), version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
